appearance.label: Expands Terminal ownership through screens and pages
Negotiated terminal modes determine input encoding
UI effects dispatched only if Surface still exists
Shared Terminal sampled under Surface's mutex
Display resize notification after PTY/emulator resize
Borrows shared font grid; Surface holds its reference

content.ascii:
Ghostty: Surface-centered session system
|
|-- Core App (src/App.zig)
|   |-- surfaces: registered *apprt.Surface; focused_surface: checked reference
|   |-- mailbox: worker-to-main-thread messages
|   |   `-- tick -> drainMailbox -> hasSurface -> Surface.handleMessage
|   |-- font_grid_set: shared, reference-counted font grids
|   |-- device: optional app-owned GPU device, borrowed by renderers
|   `-- deinit: runtime surface cleanup before shared fonts and device
|
`-- Runtime-managed surface hosts (apprt.Surface; src/apprt.zig)
    |-- Runtime chooses window/tab/split/pane; delivers events
    `-- Core Surface (src/Surface.zig): owns one terminal session
        |-- app / rt_app / rt_surface: borrowed references, not owned hosts
        |-- config: owned DerivedConfig
        |   `-- updateConfig -> derived settings to I/O and renderer mailboxes
        |-- keyboard / mouse / size / focused / visible / child_exited
        |-- keyCallback / textCallback / mouseButtonCallback
        |   |-- Binding action -> local operation or rt_app.performAction
        |   |-- Encode key/mouse/paste using io.terminal protocol state
        |   `-- queueIo -> io.queueMessage; takes ownership; readonly drops writes
        |-- sizeCallback -> resize: pixels + cell metrics + padding
        |   `-- -> queueIo(.resize) AND renderer mailbox .resize + wakeup
        |-- io: termio.Termio (src/termio/Termio.zig)
        |   |-- backend: Backend.exec -> Exec -> subprocess + PTY
        |   |-- terminal_stream: terminal.Stream(StreamHandler)
        |   |-- terminal: terminal.Terminal (the sole emulation state)
        |   `-- mailbox / derived config / current size
        |-- io_thread: termio.Thread manager; io_thr: OS thread
        |   `-- drainMailbox -> io.queueWrite; coalesces resize requests
        |-- renderer_state: renderer.State (src/renderer/State.zig)
        |   |-- terminal -> &io.terminal; NOT another owned terminal
        |   |-- mutex + preedit + renderer-facing mouse state
        |   `-- lockDemand / unlockDemand / yieldToDemand: fairness handoff
        |-- renderer: GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI)
        |   `-- Own frame state; borrow App device and shared font grid
        |-- renderer_thread: renderer.Thread manager; renderer_thr: OS thread
        |   `-- Wakeups/timers -> renderer.updateFrame / drawFrame
        |-- draw() -> renderer.drawFrame(true), also from main thread
        |-- Optional search worker and inspector
        |-- childExited(): record exit; native UI or terminal text
        |   |-- Abnormally short run -> report and return, keep surface open
        |   `-- Normal exit: wait_after_command holds; otherwise close()
        |-- close() -> rt_surface.close(needsConfirmQuit())
        |   `-- Runtime close lifecycle -> Surface.deinit()
        `-- deinit(): ordered release
            |-- Stop/join search, then renderer thread, then I/O thread
            |-- I/O thread exit -> Exec stops child and joins PTY reader
            |-- Free renderer before renderer_thread, then I/O resources
            `-- Release input/preedit/mutex/config; deref App font grid

Termio: session I/O and emulation (src/termio/Termio.zig)
|
|-- backend.exec: Exec (src/termio/Exec.zig)
|   |-- Subprocess: owns PTY and launched shell/command
|   |   `-- start() -> Pty.open + launch configured command
|   |-- Read pipeline managed by Exec threadEnter/threadExit
|   |   |-- POSIX: io-gather -> bounded rotating buffers -> io-reader
|   |   `-- Windows: blocking read and processing in one serial loop
|   `-- queueWrite() -> PTY -> child input
|-- terminal_stream: terminal.Stream(StreamHandler)
|   |-- VT parser -> handler operations
|   `-- StreamHandler (src/termio/stream_handler.zig)
|       |-- Owns multipart APC/DCS/clipboard protocol state
|       |-- terminal reference -> mutate this Termio's Terminal
|       |-- Protocol replies -> Termio mailbox -> PTY write path
|       |-- surface_mailbox -> App.mailbox -> checked main-thread dispatch
|       `-- queueRender() -> renderer wakeup (no direct native UI calls)
|-- terminal: terminal.Terminal (src/terminal/Terminal.zig)
|   |-- Geometry: rows / cols / scrolling_region / tabstops
|   |-- Protocol/session state: modes / cursor / colors / title / pwd
|   `-- screens: ScreenSet (src/terminal/ScreenSet.zig)
|       |-- all: owned Screens; primary eager, alternate lazy
|       |   `-- Each Screen (src/terminal/Screen.zig)
|       |       |-- cursor / saved_cursor / selection / charset / kitty_keyboard
|       |       |-- kitty_images / semantic_prompt / dirty
|       |       `-- pages: PageList (src/terminal/PageList.zig)
|       |           |-- Ordered pages: history through active screen
|       |           |   `-- Rows + cells (src/terminal/page.zig)
|       |           `-- Tracked pins: viewport / cursor / selection locations
|       `-- active: reference into all, not a separate Screen
|-- mailbox: input writes / protocol replies / control messages
|   `-- Surface's io_thread drains -> queueWrite -> Backend.queueWrite
|-- processOutput(bytes), invoked by Exec reader
|   |-- Lock Surface.renderer_state.mutex
|   |-- Schedule queueRender while locked, then terminal_stream.nextSlice
|   `-- Unlock; reader yieldToDemand lets pending renderer snapshot proceed
`-- resize(size), invoked after io_thread coalescing
    |-- size.grid(): reconcile pixels, cell metrics and padding
    |-- Under same terminal mutex: Backend.resize then Terminal.resize
    |   `-- Child redraw cannot be parsed with obsolete terminal dimensions
    `-- -> renderer mailbox .resize + wakeup

Renderer: per-Surface frame preparation and presentation
|
|-- GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI) (src/renderer/generic.zig)
|   |-- terminal_state: owned terminal.RenderState snapshot
|   |-- font_shaper / prepared cells / image and GPU resources
|   |-- font_grid: borrowed App shared grid (glyph atlas/cache)
|   |-- Graphics API uses borrowed App.device
|   |   `-- Compile-time Metal or OpenGL (src/renderer.zig)
|   |-- updateFrame(Surface.renderer_state)
|   |   |-- lockDemand() -> shared Terminal + viewport + dirty state
|   |   |-- May scroll viewport / advance Kitty animations while locked
|   |   |-- terminal_state.beginUpdate + copy preedit/mouse/image data
|   |   |-- unlockDemand() -> terminal_state.endUpdate() outside lock
|   |   `-- Snapshot + shaping + atlas -> cells, selection, cursor, images
|   `-- drawFrame() -> Graphics API -> runtime host surface
|
`-- Scheduling: sibling Surface.renderer_thread (src/renderer/Thread.zig)
    |-- Mailbox / wakeups / timers drive updateFrame and drawFrame
    |   `-- Incoming .resize updates display geometry
    |-- I/O queueRender -> wakeup; frame reads shared state under mutex
    |-- Surface.draw() -> drawFrame(true) can run on main thread
    `-- Teardown: join renderer thread, then free renderer before its manager
